117701.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Coconut Creek & W Pompano Beach
117701.note: A filing: Florida's registry (Sunbiz) has CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF COCONUT CREEK/POMPANO, INC. (document N95000002556, Active), whose number shows it was filed in 1995 (work/founding-years/sunbiz/names.tsv). Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22 (the first online directory), after the filing, and nothing earlier shows the center, so the filing is the year (HANDOFF 4b: a state incorporation of the center's own corporation is medium). Earlier note: Sun-Sentinel (CrownHeights.info, 21 Jan 2007): Chabad 'has several synagogues in the county, including ones in Coconut Creek, Plantation and Weston'. Chabad.org (CrownHeights.info, 27 Aug 2007): Chabad-Lubavitch of Coconut Creek & West Pompano Beach bought the former South Florida Academy of Learning building in April 2007. Start year not found yet; lead: therebbesimpact.com 1993.

3229121.name: Chabad at St. Thomas University
3229121.note: Lubavitch.com, 17 Apr 2016 ('A Model Seder at A Catholic University', also on CrownHeights.info, 20 Apr 2016): 'After meeting the students on their turf for the first time last week, Rabbi Mendy and Tzippy Weiss wasted no time engaging those attending St. Thomas University'; 'For the past 21 years, the Weisses have worked with the South Florida community nearby the university, but struggled trying to establish a Chabad presence on the campus'; the first model Seder on campus was on 14 April 2016. Its chabad.org listing went up 29 Mar 2016.
